summary: pcre2 security fix (CVE-2026-86145, CVE-2026-89156, CVE-2026-89157, and more), dnf5 new features, Firefox 159.0.1, and OpenVPN bug fix.

changes.description: Package management service with a DBus interface
changes.note:
Update to upstream version 5.4.7.

- reposync: add --latest-limit=N option
- dnf5-plugin config-manager: add vendor policy management commands
- offline: Wait for shutdown inhibitors before reboot
- offline: acquire delay lock before triggering reboot
- automatic: support IPv6 network availability checks
- Always show cursor during userconfirm
- dnf5: Add more vendor change control command-line options
- dnf5: Add --disable-vendor-policy-source CLI option
- dnf5: Suggest --with-vendor-policy in vendor change hints
- dnf5: Add --with-vendor-policy and --clear-vendor-policies CLI options
- config-manager: Allow setopt for repositories created by plugins
- deptree: Add dependency tree command plugin
- Add repository metadata cache age output
- Renamed rhsm libdnf5 plugin to rhsm-container

Update pcre2 to 10.49, fixing security issues (CVE-2026-86145, CVE-2026-89156, CVE-2026-89157, CVE-2026-89158, CVE-2026-89160, CVE-2026-89161, CVE-2026-89162, CVE-2026-103111)

Release notes:
https://github.com/PCRE2Project/pcre2/releases/tag/pcre2-10.49
https://github.com/PCRE2Project/pcre2/releases#release-pcre2-10.48

ABI changes were checked between 10.47 and 10.49 and were not found to be significant, the updates are primarily focused on fixing security vulnerabilities.
